description: Six two-input XOR gates built for digital signals, which also accept analog ones.

inputs.text: One of the two inputs into that gate; an input with nothing patched into it is ignored.

outputs.text: Goes high while exactly one of that gate's two inputs is high. Unpatched, its result passes on as a third input to the next gate in the module, chaining gates into one with more inputs.

menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
